newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 3.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 94.04 points to end at 6,517.01 as investors remained wary after the market's recent sell-off.
* Indonesia's President Suharto was scheduled to meet senior government officials on Thursday at his presidential office, palace sources said. The sources denied rumours that Suharto was not well.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 1.13 points, 0.17 percent, to close at 650.88 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,402.50/03.50 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,402.00/06.00.
* Second-liner Surya Semesta on market talk of a possible link-up with heavyweight cigarette maker Sampoerna .
* Conglomerate Astra following large cross trading by brokerage firm Bali Securities on Wednesday. Sampoerna denied it was involved in the trading.
* Ficorinvest Bank on market talk that several leading businessmen were likely to take a large stake in the bank.
* Bank Lippo after announcement of a rise in its 1996 net profit.
